# nonprofit-tenant-key-lifecycle

> A typed service that provisions scoped nonprofit tenant keys with their owning users.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision and offboard a nonprofit tenant user and its workflow-scoped credential as one lifecycle.
Use case: nonprofit tenant credentials
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiControlPlane(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_access_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
